description: MITRE ATT&CK mapping rules for red-team session log analysis

rules.name: Network Service Discovery
rules.remediation: Segment the network and deploy IDS/IPS to detect scanning activity. Use firewall rules to limit lateral scanning between VLANs.

rules.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
rules.remediation: Enable PowerShell Script Block Logging and Module Logging. Restrict PowerShell to Constrained Language Mode via AppLocker or WDAC. Monitor for encoded commands and download cradles.

rules.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell
rules.remediation: Monitor command-line process creation events. Use AppLocker to restrict cmd.exe usage for non-administrative users.

rules.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
rules.remediation: Audit shell process creation. Use auditd rules for execve monitoring. Restrict shell access to necessary users only.

rules.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
rules.remediation: Monitor registry key modifications at HKLM/HKCU Run/RunOnce. Deploy EDR with registry monitoring capabilities. Audit Startup folder contents regularly.

rules.name: System Information Discovery
rules.remediation: This is a low-severity reconnaissance technique. Monitor for bulk enumeration commands. Correlate with other suspicious activity for context.

rules.name: System Owner/User Discovery
rules.remediation: Monitor for user enumeration commands post-initial access. Correlate with privilege escalation attempts.

rules.name: OS Credential Dumping
rules.remediation: Enable Credential Guard on Windows 10+. Configure LSA protection (RunAsPPL). Monitor for LSASS access via Sysmon Event ID 10. Deploy EDR with memory protection.

rules.name: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
rules.remediation: Enable Credential Guard and LSA protection (RunAsPPL). Monitor for suspicious LSASS access patterns via Sysmon Event ID 10.

rules.name: Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task
rules.remediation: Audit scheduled task creation via Windows Event ID 4698. Restrict task creation to administrators. Monitor Task Scheduler for unexpected entries.

rules.name: Scheduled Task/Job: Cron
rules.remediation: Monitor crontab modifications. Restrict cron access via /etc/cron.allow. Audit /etc/cron.d/ and user crontabs for unexpected entries.

rules.name: Application Layer Protocol
rules.remediation: Deploy SSL/TLS inspection on egress proxies. Monitor for periodic beaconing patterns. Use DNS sinkholing and threat intelligence feeds for known C2 domains.

rules.name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
rules.remediation: Inspect outbound HTTP/S traffic via proxy. Monitor for unusual User-Agent strings and beaconing intervals. Deploy WAF for web shell detection.

rules.name: Remote Services: Remote Desktop Protocol
rules.remediation: Enforce NLA (Network Level Authentication) for RDP. Restrict RDP access via firewall to management subnets only. Enable RDP session logging.

rules.name: Remote Services: SSH
rules.remediation: Enforce key-based SSH authentication. Monitor for lateral SSH connections from compromised hosts. Use SSH certificate authorities for enterprise environments.

rules.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
rules.remediation: Monitor for LOLBins used for file downloads (certutil, bitsadmin). Restrict outbound connections to approved destinations. Enable proxy logging.

rules.name: Process Injection
rules.remediation: Deploy EDR with process injection detection. Enable Sysmon for cross-process activity monitoring. Use Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rules.

rules.name: Valid Accounts
rules.remediation: Enforce MFA for all accounts. Monitor for unexpected account creation events (Windows 4720, Linux useradd in auth.log). Implement PAM for privileged access.

rules.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
rules.remediation: Monitor DNS query lengths and volume for DNS tunneling indicators. Restrict outbound protocols. Deploy DLP on egress points.

rules.name: Indicator Removal: File Deletion
rules.remediation: Enable centralized log collection (SIEM) to preserve logs even after local deletion. Monitor for log clearing events (Windows 1102, 104).

rules.name: Account Discovery
rules.remediation: Monitor for bulk AD enumeration queries. Restrict LDAP query access. Deploy honeypot accounts to detect enumeration.

rules.name: Network Share Discovery
rules.remediation: Restrict SMB access between workstation segments. Monitor for share enumeration. Disable unnecessary network shares.

rules.name: Remote System Discovery
rules.remediation: Deploy network segmentation and monitor for ARP/ICMP sweep patterns on IDS. Disable LLMNR and NetBIOS-NS.

rules.name: Brute Force
rules.remediation: Implement account lockout policies. Enable MFA. Monitor for multiple failed authentication attempts in SIEM. Use progressive delays.

rules.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
rules.remediation: Patch public-facing applications promptly. Deploy WAF with virtual patching. Conduct regular vulnerability scans and penetration tests.

rules.name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
rules.remediation: Keep systems patched. Audit SUID/SGID binaries. Remove unnecessary sudo privileges. Deploy kernel exploit mitigations (SMEP, SMAP, KASLR).

rules.name: Protocol Tunneling
rules.remediation: Monitor for unusual outbound connections and tunneling indicators. Block unauthorized tunnel tools. Inspect encrypted traffic at egress.

rules.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
rules.remediation: Enable Tamper Protection for Windows Defender. Monitor for security tool stoppage events. Use EDR with self-protection capabilities.
